data.long_meaning: Jahankhatoon is a Persian name derived from the Arabic words 'jahan' meaning world and 'khatun' meaning lady or queen. This name signifies the 'Moon of the World' or the most beautiful and cherished one in the world. The name jahankhatoon carries the meaning “The Moon of the World” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose jahankhatoon usually hope their child will grow to embody the moon of the world and live with faith, good character and purpose.
